_comment: The `check --json` payload as of schema 1, before advisories existed.
The GitHub action parses this shape and is pinned by a moving v1 tag, so a
changed or removed field breaks every consumer at once while a new one is
invisible to anything that does not look for it.
tests/checkAdvisories.test.ts asserts every key below still exists and still
means the same thing. Adding to this file is wrong: it records what the
contract WAS, which is the whole point of comparing against it.
